STRATEGY: Parent starts C, uses TFT for n<8, then thresholds, defects when opponent seems cooperative, occasionally defects if my_c > opp_c+10, and does not defect on last round. Simulated probes: one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D. Proposed changes: defect always on last round, defect 100% against sustained_D, better detect periodic_D and exploit non-responsive opponents.

The trace simulates it against one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, and periodic_D, then revises it by adding a probe at round 3, exploit detection via non-punish ratio, high-defection-rate rules, and a modified forgiving TFT that only forgives when opponent defection rate is below 0.5.

STRATEGY: Parent is a forgiving TFT variant that cooperates after opponent defection when the opponent's overall defection rate is below 0.5, plus exploit-detection and endgame defection rules. Simulated against ALLD, four_D_TFT, and periodic_D using the report's statistics. Changed by adding the opp_d/n < 0.5 rate condition to the forgiveness branch.
